method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text from the seat of the individual taxpayer, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE (nonresidents, part-year residents and tax years 2022-2024 answer `not covered`, asserted); checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.

scope: The individual income tax of a full-year resident: filing requirement (s 12-6-4910(1)), due dates and extension (ss 12-6-4970, 12-6-4980, 12-6-4990), joint or separate (s 12-6-5000), South Carolina taxable income from federal taxable income (ss 12-6-1110, 12-6-1120(1), (2), (4), 12-6-1130(2), 12-6-1140(13), 12-6-1150, 12-6-1160, 12-6-1170(A)-(B)), the rates (s 12-6-510(B), 2025 schedule), credits (ss 12-6-3330, 12-6-3380, 12-6-3632). Out: nonresidents and part-year residents, 2022-2024 rates, s 12-6-1171, other credits, entities, withholding, penalties.
seat: the individual taxpayer (a South Carolina resident, alone or with a spouse on a joint return)
links: us/internal-revenue-code-of-1986 (federal taxable income, gross income, standard deduction, exemption amount, EITC, IRC s 21; not imported)
